data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'kh-t-m', meaning 'to cover'. Akhtam means 'warrior, brave' in the Arabic language. In the context of Islamic tradition, it represents a strong and courageous individual. The name Akhtam carries the meaning “Warrior, brave” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Akhtam usually hope their child will grow to embody warrior, brave and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Akhtam total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
